title: Filtered colimits of flat modules are flat
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ a small filtered category (for instance a nonempty directed set) and $i\mapsto M_i$ a functor from $I$ to the category of $R$-modules, with transition maps $M(a):M_i\to M_j$ for $a:i\to j$, such that every $M_i$ is a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $(M,(\mu_i:M_i\to M)_i)$ be a colimit of this diagram in the category of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $M$ is a flat $R$-module.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05UT (lemma-colimit-flat), line 8660: a directed colimit of flat $R$-modules is flat; proof by commutation of tensor products with colimits and exactness of directed colimits

proof.text: Let $u:N_1\to N_2$ be an injective $R$-linear map. By [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] we must show that $u\otimes1_M:N_1\otimes_RM\to N_2\otimes_RM$ is injective. Composing with the canonical isomorphisms $N_k\otimes_RM\cong M\otimes_RN_k$, $n\otimes m\mapsto m\otimes n$, which commute with $u\otimes1$ and $1\otimes u$, it is equivalent to show that $1_M\otimes u:M\otimes_RN_1\to M\otimes_RN_2$ is injective; likewise, for each $i$, flatness of $M_i$ says that $f_i:=1_{M_i}\otimes u:M_i\otimes_RN_1\to M_i\otimes_RN_2$ is injective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 10.39.3 (Tag 05UT, lemma-colimit-flat), line 8660, with Lemma 10.12.9 (Tag 00DD, lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits, line 1934) and Lemma 10.8.8 (Tag 00DB, lemma-directed-colimit-exact, line 908)

proof.text: Put $P_i=M_i\otimes_RN_1$ and $Q_i=M_i\otimes_RN_2$, functors of $i$ with transition maps $M(a)\otimes1$. By [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-commutes-with-colimits] (applied with $N=N_1$ and with $N=N_2$), $M\otimes_RN_1$ with the maps $p_i=\mu_i\otimes1:P_i\to M\otimes_RN_1$ is a colimit of $(P_i)$, and $M\otimes_RN_2$ with $q_i=\mu_i\otimes1:Q_i\to M\otimes_RN_2$ is a colimit of $(Q_i)$ in the category of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The maps $f_i$ form a morphism of diagrams: $f_j\circ(M(a)\otimes1)=M(a)\otimes u=(M(a)\otimes1)\circ f_i$ for $a:i\to j$, checked on pure tensors; and $f:=1_M\otimes u$ satisfies $f\circ p_i=\mu_i\otimes u=q_i\circ f_i$ for all $i$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 10.39.3 (Tag 05UT, lemma-colimit-flat), line 8660, with Lemma 10.12.9 (Tag 00DD, lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits, line 1934) and Lemma 10.8.8 (Tag 00DB, lemma-directed-colimit-exact, line 908)

proof.text: $f$ is injective (directed/filtered colimits are exact, Tag 00DB, in the case of a left-exact sequence $0\to P_i\to Q_i$). Let $x\in M\otimes_RN_1$ with $f(x)=0$. Since $I$ is filtered, by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise](1) applied to the colimit $(M\otimes_RN_1,(p_i))$ of step 2, $x=p_i(y)$ for some $i$ and $y\in P_i$. Then $0=f(p_i(y))=q_i(f_i(y))$, so by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise](2) (the case $\iota_i(x)=0$) applied to the colimit $(M\otimes_RN_2,(q_i))$ there is a morphism $a:i\to k$ with $(M(a)\otimes1)(f_i(y))=0$, i.e. $f_k((M(a)\otimes1)(y))=0$ by the naturality of step 2. As $f_k$ is injective (step 1), $(M(a)\otimes1)(y)=0$, hence $x=p_i(y)=p_k((M(a)\otimes1)(y))=0$. So $1_M\otimes u$ is injective, and by step 1 $M$ is flat.

split_report.summary: Mathlib re-searched with LeanSearch, Loogle, LeanFinder and grep: no theorem that a direct limit or filtered colimit of flat modules is flat (only direct sums, Module.Flat.directSum); not a leaf. Statement made precise: the vague 'filtered (directed) system' became a functor from a small filtered category (the citer lem-weil-pbc-henselization-flat-quotients applies it to the filtered category of etale algebras of lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization, not a directed set), with def-weil-pbc-category-colimit added to stmt_deps. Proof follows Stacks 05UT in three steps: reduce flatness to injectivity of 1_M (x) u by symmetry of tensor; tensor commutes with colimits (lem-weil-pbc-tensor-commutes-with-colimits, Mathlib leaf) so 1_M (x) u is the colimit of the injective maps 1_{M_i} (x) u; injectivity of a filtered colimit of injections (the case 0->P->Q of Stacks 00DB) written out from the elementwise description lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise (Mathlib leaf), which holds for filtered categories, so no reduction to directed sets (Categories 04AX) is needed. No new nodes.
